subject: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com>, Patrick O'Neil <patrick.oneil@clearbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios

Hi Emma / Patrick —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clean kickoff path for the evaluation sprint: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce per-message inference cost while keeping user-facing accuracy at or above your current proprietary baseline.
- Key risk: regression on intent extraction and entity recall for the top-6 intents in your product flows.
- Compliance asks: need SOC2 evidence and a short data-retention statement for the pilot.

What we propose
1) Short 2-week trial focusing on the three highest-volume intents (billing, reset, plan-change) using your sample prompts and logs.
2) Parallel model candidates: an open model candidate (Llama-3-Chat-32b-q4) and a Redwood-optimized variant (Redwood-Turbo-XL-quant). We will also run the trial against your current proprietary baseline for parity checks.
3) Acceptance scenarios: we suggest the following thresholds for the sprint readout — intent accuracy >= 90%, actionable entity F1 >= 88%, hallucination <= 3% measured on the provided prompt set. If the open model meets these gates we can discuss rollout and cost projections.

Deliverables we will provide before kickoff:
- Benchmark harness (link below) with the prompt bundle you shared.
- A parity acceptance template (attached) for sign-off.
- SOC2 summary + data-retention statement.

Next steps / asks for you
- Share the 2-week sample prompt set and ~500 de-identified examples (CSV). I attached a short sample prompts template you can drop data into.
- Confirm procurement contact for a one-off evaluation PO (if required).
- If you want, we can lock in a kickoff window Wed/Thu this week (I proposed options below).

Attachments: clearbridge_sample_prompts.csv, parity_acceptance_template.xlsx

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/clearbridge/eval-benchmarks (benchmark harness)

Thanks — looking forward to running this quickly and getting a concrete parity readout.

—Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0172
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Patrick O'Neil <patrick.oneil@clearbridge.com>, Clearbridge Procurement <procurement@clearbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios

Markus —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 
- Procurement: looping in procurement for the PO. Expect a standard one-off eval PO; they will want an SOW and the pricing for the 2-week trial.
- Security: I attached our security questionnaire (redacted). We need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note confirming that any de-identified examples will not be stored beyond the trial window unless we explicitly approve.
- Technical: curious if the Redwood-optimized variant will be quantized for the GPU infra or run in fp16. Also please confirm tokenization compatibility with the sample prompts (we have some unicode heavy fields).

We can do Wednesday 08/04 10:00am ET for a 30-min kickoff.

Attachments: clearbridge_security_questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Emma Sullivan
Head of ML Integrations | Clearbridge Capital
emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios

Emma / Markus —

Short answers:
- SOC2: we will send a SOC2 summary and an access-limited Evidence Package via the link below by EOD Wednesday. Full Type II report is available under NDA; summary should satisfy your procurement first pass.
- Redwood variant: Redwood-Turbo-XL-quant will be provided in a 4-bit quantized path optimized for serving; we will also run an fp16 baseline to validate quality delta. Tokenization: we verify tokenization parity in the harness step and will flag unicode mismatches.
- Data retention: we will enforce a 14-day retention for trial artifacts unless you request otherwise; we will not retain raw examples beyond that window without explicit approval.

Model candidates to validate in the sprint: 
- Open candidate: Llama-3-Chat-32b-q4 (community release) — lower cost path, known to be strong on instruction following with prompt engineering.
- Redwood-optimized candidate: Redwood-Turbo-XL-quant — lower-latency inference path with continuous-batching enabled.
- Baseline: your existing CustomerBase-v2 (we will run blind A/B against the provided baseline dataset you share).

I'll populate the parity_acceptance_template.xlsx with the default thresholds (intent accuracy, entity F1, hallucination %) and upload to the shared Drive.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Patrick O'Neil <patrick.oneil@clearbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 07:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios

Marissa / Markus —

Thanks for the context. A couple of follow-ups from the product side: 
- Quality regression concern: our legal/product leads will require that any open-model candidate demonstrate no more than a 2% delta in critical-intent accuracy vs our baseline on the provided holdout. For edge cases we care about (multi-intent blurring), can you describe the failure modes you expect and mitigation approaches?
- Metrics: are the hallucination tests you run automated or human-annotated? We prefer a small human-annotated evaluation set for hallucination assessment even if you have automated heuristics.
- Timeline: we need the sprint + readout completed within two weeks to make a go/no-go decision in the next procurement window. Is that feasible?

If we can confirm the acceptance gates (we can be flexible on exact numbers but need the regression delta guarded), procurement will expedite the eval PO.

—Patrick
Director, Product Integrations | Clearbridge Capital
patrick.oneil@clearbridge.com
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@clearbridge.com>, Patrick O'Neil <patrick.oneil@clearbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Clearbridge Procurement <procurement@clearbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Open model adoption path & acceptance scenarios

Patrick / Emma —

Thanks — short answers and a proposed concrete plan: 

1) Failure modes & mitigations:
- Multi-intent blurring: we'll add intent disambiguation prompts and a confidence threshold for fallback to baseline. We will instrument a quick-rule-based post-filter as a safety net during the trial.
- Rare-entity drop: we'll boost entity examples for the 8 rarest entities and run focused augmentation during the first 48 hours to avoid recall regressions.

2) Hallucination measurement: hybrid approach — automated heuristics for bulk triage + a 300-example human-annotated holdout set for final readout. We will budget reviewer time within the sprint.

3) Timeline: two-week sprint is feasible. Suggested schedule:
- Kickoff: Wed 08/04 10:00am ET (as proposed)
- Data ingest & harnessing: Day 1-2
- Experiments & tuning: Days 3-10
- Human annotation & readout: Days 11-14

4) Acceptance gates (proposed final):
- Critical-intent accuracy: no more than 2% regression vs baseline on the holdout (same as your ask).
- Entity F1: within 3 points of baseline for top-12 entities.
- Hallucination: <= 3% on human-annotated holdout.

Next steps I will take now: upload SOC2 summary + parity template to the Drive, send an eval SOW to procurement, and lock the kickoff time. Please confirm procurement contact or forward the PO instructions and we'll send the SOW.
